function: Excluded (above_phy): MADDPG learns UAV and ARIS trajectories and UAV mode switching, while ARIS phase shifts come from SDR optimization (pp. 6, 9).
notes: Multi-UAV NOMA data collection with an aerial RIS (arXiv:2412.20484v1). The only learned part is MADDPG, whose action is the flying direction and speed, p. 6: "flying direction and speed in each time slot", and in the dual-mode scheme the active or passive mode of each UAV, p. 9: "we also employ the MADDPG to update the mode-switching strategy". The ARIS phase shifts and the GU association come from SDR and alternating optimization with a penalty and SCA (p. 7), so no physical-layer decision is learned; GU transmit power is fixed (p. 5). Mode switching is read as a role choice between active AP and passive reflector, not a phase-shift design, for the reviewer to confirm. The text layer of pages 12 to 14 holds only figure labels, so pages 10 to 14 were read as images.
